application: MRI adaptive acquisition and sequence orchestration
current_baseline: Fixed or protocol-driven pulse sequences acquire k-space data and reconstruct images before downstream interpretation.
proposed_role: Use local anatomical/physiological support, motion and safety compatibility, and quantitative guard conditions to adapt which measurements are acquired next.
boundary: Addition to MRI acquisition and control; not a magnet replacement.
core_operators: direct state query; next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance
exemplar_event_guard: Acquire the next encoding block when predicted information gain or quantitative uncertainty crosses a declared threshold and safety constraints remain satisfied.
auditable_absence: Expected calibration, physiological gating or coil data fail to arrive within the sequence window despite verified sensor coverage.
candidate_metrics: Diagnostic task performance; scan time; acquired samples; SAR and gradient limits; motion artifacts; events/J; false-adaptation rate.
minimum_pilot: Retrospective raw-data replay, then a phantom or volunteer study with a locked protocol and conventional reconstruction reference.
principal_risks: Adaptive bias; missed pathology; instability; regulatory validation; patient safety.

application: MRI physics-constrained direct parameter query
current_baseline: Conventional pipelines produce images, then estimate tissue or functional parameters.
proposed_role: Represent Bloch-model-compatible signal families as relations and query selected parameters or change events directly, optionally using images as a view.
boundary: Partial replacement of selected reconstruction stages for bounded tasks.
evidence: Cross-domain inference supported by quantitative MRI
core_operators: direct state query; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Parameter posterior or certified interval enters a clinically meaningful range under sufficient acquisition support.
auditable_absence: A parameter cannot be certified because the required excitation/encoding support was never observed.
candidate_metrics: Parameter bias/variance; calibration; scan time; task AUC; reconstruction energy; uncertainty coverage.
minimum_pilot: Phantom study comparing direct parameter estimates, MRF-style matching and standard image-first workflow.
principal_risks: Model mismatch; dictionary/expression growth; non-identifiability; clinical interpretability.

application: MRI narrow diagnostic instrument as an alternative to full imaging
current_baseline: Full MRI forms general-purpose images even when the clinical question is narrow.
proposed_role: Design a task-specific MR instrument that answers a bounded question such as relaxation change, flow threshold or lesion-presence probability without requiring a full diagnostic image.
boundary: Alternative narrow instrument; full MRI replacement unsupported.
core_operators: direct state query; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: A task-specific signal relation crosses a validated threshold with confidence and safety conditions satisfied.
auditable_absence: The expected signal support is absent, but only after coil, sequence and coverage integrity are verified.
candidate_metrics: Sensitivity/specificity; acquisition time; energy; footprint; cost; inconclusive rate; referral-to-full-MRI rate.
minimum_pilot: Start with a benchtop NMR/MR phantom and a single quantitative task.
principal_risks: Loss of generality; hidden confounders; regulatory burden; false reassurance.

application: MRI motion, respiratory and cardiac event gating
current_baseline: Motion correction often relies on repeated acquisition, navigators or retrospective processing.
proposed_role: Treat motion/physiology as continuous state and solve for compatible acquisition windows or correction events rather than replaying uniform frames.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: Predicted motion enters an admissible window and a sequence block is admitted; otherwise hold or redirect.
auditable_absence: A required quiet-window event never occurs within the allowed interval.
candidate_metrics: Rejected acquisitions; reacquisition rate; image/parameter quality; latency; patient time.
minimum_pilot: Integrate an external motion sensor with retrospective MR sequence logs.
principal_risks: Sensor drift; phase mismatch; prolonged scans; selection bias.

application: MRI safety and implant compatibility engine
current_baseline: Safety screening is document- and workflow-heavy and can fail when implant identity or conditions are incomplete.
proposed_role: Model implant identity, field strength, sequence limits and patient state as a compatibility predicate with provenance and explicit reason codes.
core_operators: compatibility gate; lineage/provenance; auditable absence; guard/event surface
exemplar_event_guard: Scan becomes admissible only when all required device attributes and MR-conditional constraints are present and current.
auditable_absence: Missing implant identity or condition is logged as a blocking absence, not silently treated as safe.
candidate_metrics: Screening completeness; prevented unsafe scans; delay time; override rate; auditability.
minimum_pilot: FHIR-compatible registry and rules engine in one MRI service line.
principal_risks: Incorrect device metadata; stale labeling; workflow bypass; privacy.

application: Ultrasound echo-event acquisition and beam control
current_baseline: Uniform RF sampling and image formation precede measurement of most clinical features.
proposed_role: Use level-crossing or feature-triggered acquisition, local beam support and direct arrival-time/flow events to reduce irrelevant conversion and processing.
boundary: Addition or partial replacement of acquisition/reconstruction for narrow tasks.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; guard/event surface; analog/photonic front end; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Echo arrival, Doppler shift or tissue-boundary relation crosses a validated threshold within the beam support.
auditable_absence: Expected echo absent only when transducer contact and acoustic coverage are verified.
candidate_metrics: Samples/event; energy; latency; sensitivity; localization error; image equivalence when a view is produced.
minimum_pilot: Phantom and flow-loop test with simultaneous conventional RF capture.
principal_risks: Information loss; nonlinear propagation; aliasing; difficult certification.

application: CT/PET task-specific sparse acquisition
current_baseline: Tomographic systems acquire projections and reconstruct volumetric images before many decisions.
proposed_role: Select measurement supports adaptively and solve for bounded findings or quantitative changes with explicit uncertainty, retaining full reconstruction as fallback.
core_operators: direct state query; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Task confidence reaches a preset boundary without violating dose/count constraints.
auditable_absence: A required angular or count support is absent; result remains inconclusive rather than negative.
candidate_metrics: Dose or tracer counts; task performance; scan time; uncertainty; fallback rate.
minimum_pilot: Digital phantom and archived raw-data challenge.
principal_risks: Dose-selection bias; hallucinated structure; regulatory validation.

application: Microscopy and cell-culture event microscope
current_baseline: High-throughput microscopy generates large image stacks that are later searched for rare events.
proposed_role: Use local optical supports, event sensors or analog prefilters to emit only lineage-aware cell events such as division, migration, morphology change or fluorescence threshold crossing.
boundary: Addition and, for narrow assays, partial replacement of continuous imaging.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; analog/photonic front end
exemplar_event_guard: A tracked cell lineage crosses a morphology, intensity or interaction guard with sufficient optical support.
auditable_absence: Expected cell or marker observation absent only when field coverage and sensor health are known.
candidate_metrics: Events/J; bytes/experiment; missed/false events; lineage accuracy; phototoxic exposure.
minimum_pilot: Parallel conventional imaging and event extraction on a well-defined assay.
principal_risks: Rare-event miss; lineage swaps; optical drift; loss of serendipitous observations.

application: ICU and ward event-native patient monitoring
current_baseline: Continuous monitors produce dense streams and alarm fatigue while context is split across systems.
proposed_role: Maintain a continuous patient state, local physiological supports, compatibility with interventions and an auditable event record for threshold crossings and trends.
boundary: Addition to monitoring and clinical decision support.
core_operators: direct state query; next-event solve; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: A validated physiological relation crosses a severity guard and matches the patient context, sensor quality and treatment phase.
auditable_absence: Expected vital, medication response or reassessment is absent despite confirmed observation coverage.
candidate_metrics: Alarm precision/recall; time to recognition; clinician workload; missed-data rate; intervention outcomes.
minimum_pilot: Silent-mode retrospective validation followed by prospective shadow deployment.
principal_risks: Alarm overreach; sensor artifacts; automation bias; privacy; clinical liability.

application: Surgical navigation and tool-tissue time-of-contact
current_baseline: Navigation and collision checks often run at fixed update rates and depend on reconstructed scenes.
proposed_role: Represent tool and anatomy trajectories continuously; solve certified time-of-contact events within local support and surgical permissions.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance
exemplar_event_guard: Earliest predicted tool/tissue contact or no-go-zone crossing under uncertainty.
auditable_absence: Tracking signal absence blocks the action rather than implying clearance.
candidate_metrics: Contact-time error; missed crossings; latency; false stops; surgeon workload.
minimum_pilot: Simulation and benchtop phantom with a conventional navigation baseline.
principal_risks: Deformable anatomy; tracking dropout; model error; safety certification.

application: Medication, infusion and closed-loop therapy guard engine
current_baseline: Orders, pump state, labs and observations are often stored in separate snapshots.
proposed_role: Join medication identity, dose lineage, patient state, timing and device status through compatibility and event guards; keep clinicians in the loop.
core_operators: compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence; next-event solve
exemplar_event_guard: Dose or infusion transition is admitted only when patient, order, pump, drug, route and timing are compatible.
auditable_absence: Expected reassessment, pump acknowledgment or lab result is missing after its due interval.
candidate_metrics: Medication errors; delayed doses; false blocks; response-monitoring completeness; audit time.
minimum_pilot: One high-risk infusion pathway in simulation and shadow mode.
principal_risks: Rule brittleness; alert fatigue; override handling; governance.

application: Cradle-to-life longitudinal patient journey substrate
current_baseline: Hospital records are encounter- and document-centric; identity and context fragment across organizations and life stages.
proposed_role: Use a stable person lineage with prenatal, birth, neonatal, childhood, adult and elder branches; represent encounters and documents as views over a consent- and provenance-aware event graph.
boundary: Addition beneath EHRs; not an autonomous medical authority.
core_operators: direct state query; lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Care transitions, referrals, procedures, consent changes and outcomes are typed events tied to the person lineage.
auditable_absence: Expected follow-up, screening, handoff, result or support service is absent only under an explicit obligation and coverage rule.
candidate_metrics: Record-linkage errors; care-gap closure; duplicate testing; handoff failures; patient access; consent compliance.
minimum_pilot: One maternal-neonatal or chronic-care pathway across two organizations using FHIR events and PROV lineage.
principal_risks: Identity matching; privacy; institutional power; data quality; patient autonomy.

application: Maternal, fetal, birth and neonatal journey coordination
current_baseline: Prenatal, delivery, neonatal and maternal records often sit in separate episodes and systems.
proposed_role: Model mother, fetus/newborn, samples, devices and care teams as related but distinct lineages, with consent and event transitions at birth.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; guard/event surface
exemplar_event_guard: Birth, transfer, screening, feeding, medication and follow-up transitions preserve parent/child lineage and provenance.
auditable_absence: Expected screening or post-discharge follow-up is absent with verified obligation and outreach coverage.
candidate_metrics: Missed screens; duplicate identity; handoff delay; maternal/newborn linkage accuracy.
minimum_pilot: Neonatal screening and follow-up pathway.
principal_risks: Identity errors; consent complexity; sensitive data exposure.

application: Hospital flow, beds, theatres and discharge event twin
current_baseline: Hospitals use dashboards and periodic snapshots that can obscure pending transitions and missing actions.
proposed_role: Represent patient flow, rooms, staff, equipment and constraints as a compatibility-gated event system with next-event and counterfactual queries.
core_operators: direct state query; next-event solve; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: A transfer or discharge becomes admissible when clinical, staffing, bed, transport and documentation conditions are satisfied.
auditable_absence: Required consult, result, transport or discharge action has not occurred by the due interval.
candidate_metrics: Length of stay; boarding time; cancelled procedures; idle beds; false-ready rate; staff burden.
minimum_pilot: One ward-to-discharge process in shadow mode.
principal_risks: Optimization against patient welfare; unstable priorities; data latency.

application: Mental-health longitudinal care and research substrate
current_baseline: Care is often reduced to episodic diagnoses and self-report snapshots.
proposed_role: Maintain patient-authored goals, consent, context, development, environment, observations and interventions as lineage-aware events and dimensional trajectories.
boundary: Addition to records and research; not automated diagnosis or therapy.
core_operators: direct state query; lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: A care or research transition is admitted under explicit consent, role, time and safety predicates, with human review.
auditable_absence: Expected check-in or follow-up may be logged as absent, but lack of digital activity is never equated with deterioration without corroboration.
candidate_metrics: Continuity; patient control; follow-up completion; bias; clinician burden; data access.
minimum_pilot: Patient-controlled longitudinal research registry with independent ethics review.
principal_risks: Surveillance; stigma; coercion; false inference; crisis responsibility.

application: Clinical trial and observational study event graph
current_baseline: Trials rely on document bundles, site databases and retrospective reconciliation.
proposed_role: Create a versioned event and provenance graph connecting protocol, consent, intervention, measurement, deviation, analysis and publication.
boundary: Addition/partial replacement of document-centric trial operations.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Every trial action creates a typed event with protocol version, authority, subject, time and before/after state.
auditable_absence: Expected visit, sample, outcome or adverse-event assessment is explicitly expired, waived or observed.
candidate_metrics: Protocol deviations; reconciliation time; missing data; audit readiness; reproducibility.
minimum_pilot: Single-site prospective study with export to standard regulatory documents.
principal_risks: Operational complexity; privacy; legal admissibility; version drift.

application: Biomedical sample and biobank lineage
current_baseline: Samples are split, pooled, transformed and shipped across systems.
proposed_role: Use lineage addresses and split/merge rules for specimen, aliquot, derivative, assay and storage events.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; guard/event surface
exemplar_event_guard: A sample transition is admitted only when identity, consent, chain of custody, storage and assay compatibility are satisfied.
auditable_absence: Expected receipt, temperature record or assay result is missing after verified custody.
candidate_metrics: Misidentification; unusable samples; audit time; consent violations; freezer excursions.
minimum_pilot: One biobank workflow with barcode/EPCIS and PROV mapping.
principal_risks: Legacy identifiers; merge ambiguity; privacy; operational adoption.

application: Protein dynamics and molecular-event simulation
current_baseline: Molecular dynamics often advances short timesteps and stores frames; structure repositories emphasize snapshots.
proposed_role: For selected relation families, solve binding, contact, conformational and threshold events directly, while retaining conventional simulation for unresolved regions.
core_operators: direct state query; next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance
exemplar_event_guard: Earliest compatible contact, barrier crossing or conformational transition within a bounded model.
auditable_absence: A predicted event is absent only when the modeled support and force field are valid; otherwise unknown.
candidate_metrics: Event-time error; energy conservation; missed states; compute/J; expression growth.
minimum_pilot: Small molecule or coarse-grained benchmark against MD trajectories.
principal_risks: Chaotic dynamics; model inadequacy; event explosion; no general closed form.

application: CRISPR and gene-editing in-silico candidate pruning
current_baseline: Guide design uses sequence search, predictive models and experimental validation.
proposed_role: Use local genomic/epigenetic support, compatibility predicates and lineage to rank candidate interventions and downstream event risks before laboratory testing.
boundary: Addition to design; not physical gene control.
core_operators: local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; counterfactual branch
exemplar_event_guard: Candidate passes sequence, structure, cell-context, off-target and policy guards with uncertainty.
auditable_absence: Missing cell-context evidence is a blocking absence, not proof of safety.
candidate_metrics: Off-target ranking; experimental hit rate; uncertainty calibration; provenance.
minimum_pilot: Benchmark on public datasets; no clinical use.
principal_risks: Overconfidence; incomplete biology; dual use; ethical concerns.

application: Public-health event and service-absence observatory
current_baseline: Public-health systems aggregate delayed reports and dashboards.
proposed_role: Use event notifications, local geographic supports, lineage and explicit expected-report contracts to distinguish true absence, delayed data and sensor failure.
core_operators: local support; compatibility gate; auditable absence; lineage/provenance; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Case, lab, wastewater, capacity or intervention events cross a public-health guard.
auditable_absence: Expected report absent only after source coverage, reporting obligation and deadline are verified.
candidate_metrics: Reporting delay; missingness classification; false alarms; privacy; action time.
minimum_pilot: One syndromic or wastewater surveillance program with transparent absence rules.
principal_risks: Re-identification; political misuse; reporting bias; jurisdiction conflicts.

application: ASML/EUV event-native exposure and scanner control
current_baseline: EUV systems project reticle patterns using complex optics, stages, sources and tightly coupled feedback.
proposed_role: Add a query-first state/event layer for wafer-stage trajectories, dose, focus, overlay, contamination and subsystem readiness.
boundary: Addition to scanner control; physical exposure system remains.
core_operators: direct state query; next-event solve; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: Expose only when stage, source, reticle, wafer, focus, dose and safety states are compatible; latch deviations as events.
auditable_absence: Expected metrology, droplet/source, stage or vacuum readiness event is absent within the control window.
candidate_metrics: Overlay; focus/dose error; wafers/hour; downtime; false aborts; control energy.
minimum_pilot: Offline replay of scanner logs and a hardware-in-the-loop subsystem test.
principal_risks: Proprietary complexity; nanometre tolerances; latency; certification.

application: Computational lithography hotspot query engine
current_baseline: OPC, SMO and verification optimize masks, source and process over large pattern spaces.
proposed_role: Represent pattern constraints and process windows as local supports and guards; query hotspot events and compatible corrections instead of materializing every candidate globally.
boundary: Addition/partial replacement of selected optimization passes.
core_operators: direct state query; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: A local pattern/process relation exits the manufacturable window under a declared model.
auditable_absence: No hotspot observation is valid only under verified model coverage; unmodeled pattern classes remain unknown.
candidate_metrics: Runtime; memory; hotspot recall; process-window improvement; correction complexity.
minimum_pilot: Public benchmark or synthetic mask set comparing local event solver with conventional simulation.
principal_risks: Model closure; missed long-range effects; stochastic resist behavior; IP constraints.

application: Reduced-order Maxwell/rigorous simulation query service
current_baseline: Full electromagnetic simulation can be expensive across many source-mask-process combinations.
proposed_role: Compile bounded parameter families into reduced or surrogate relation models with certified validity regions and fall back to full solvers outside support.
core_operators: direct state query; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Parameter query is answered only within certified support and error tolerance.
auditable_absence: A result is absent/inconclusive when the query lies outside the reduced model support.
candidate_metrics: Error bound; solver speed; fallback rate; memory; process-window coverage.
minimum_pilot: Reduced-basis study on a narrow mask family.
principal_risks: Extrapolation; hidden coupling; certification overhead.

application: Reticle, wafer and process lineage graph
current_baseline: Mask versions, lots, wafers, recipes, metrology and rework form complex provenance chains.
proposed_role: Use immutable lineage, split/merge and event records across design, mask, exposure, etch, metrology and yield.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Every custody, recipe, exposure, inspection and disposition creates a versioned event.
auditable_absence: Expected metrology, hold release or lot movement is absent after a declared due interval.
candidate_metrics: Root-cause time; genealogy completeness; scrap containment; auditability.
minimum_pilot: One process module or product family.
principal_risks: Identifier mismatch; data volume; supplier boundaries; confidentiality.

application: Wafer-stage and robot continuous motion scheduling
current_baseline: High-speed stages and robots require precise coordination and collision avoidance.
proposed_role: Use continuous trajectories, local supports and exact/conservative time-of-impact events rather than only fixed-rate checking.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface
exemplar_event_guard: Earliest contact, clearance or timing-constraint crossing under bounded trajectory uncertainty.
auditable_absence: Tracking absence blocks motion; it never implies free space.
candidate_metrics: Cycle time; missed collision probability; false stops; timing jitter.
minimum_pilot: Digital twin and hardware-in-the-loop stage/robot cell.
principal_risks: Trajectory uncertainty; flexible structures; numerical degeneracy.

application: Fab chamber next-fault digital twin
current_baseline: Process chambers are monitored by dense sensor streams and periodic models.
proposed_role: Represent pressure, temperature, flow, plasma, chemistry and equipment states continuously; solve next-fault and regime-change events with calibrated uncertainty.
evidence: Corpus event calculus + industrial twin pattern
core_operators: direct state query; next-event solve; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: Earliest compatible threshold or regime transition under a validated physical model.
auditable_absence: Expected sensor or actuator acknowledgment absent with coverage known.
candidate_metrics: Unplanned downtime; false alarms; yield; maintenance hours; model error.
minimum_pilot: One chamber subsystem in shadow mode.
principal_risks: Model drift; rare faults; sensor bias; action latency.

application: Metrology optical prefilter and B.C.E. detector
current_baseline: Metrology often digitizes broad optical signals before feature extraction.
proposed_role: Use calibrated waveguide/optofluidic transfer functions and compatibility gates to detect narrow optical events before full digitization.
evidence: Corpus Hollowlens pattern + established component classes
core_operators: local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; analog/photonic front end; lineage/provenance
exemplar_event_guard: Selected wavelength/polarization/mode response crosses a calibrated guard.
auditable_absence: Expected reference-channel event absent indicates drift or hardware fault, not sample absence.
candidate_metrics: Verified events/J; insertion loss; miss/false rate; calibration interval; throughput.
minimum_pilot: Hollowlens-style benchtop metrology proxy with electronic baseline.
principal_risks: Optical loss; drift; liquid instability; ADC still needed; limited task range.

application: PCB routing, revision and signal-integrity event graph
current_baseline: EDA represents geometry and runs rule checks, while revision and trace identity can fragment.
proposed_role: Treat traces, vias, components and constraints as lineage-aware relations; use local support for clearance and compatibility for electrical/net semantics.
core_operators: local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; counterfactual branch
exemplar_event_guard: Clearance, impedance, timing or net-compatibility relation crosses a guard.
auditable_absence: Expected test or sign-off absent is explicit.
candidate_metrics: DRC runtime; missed violations; revision traceability; ECO turnaround.
minimum_pilot: One board design with conventional DRC reference.
principal_risks: Nonlocal electromagnetic effects; rule explosion; tool integration.

application: Pick-and-place event-native cell
current_baseline: Robots use cameras, maps and fixed-cycle control to locate, pick and place parts.
proposed_role: Combine continuous motion, local supports, compatibility and lineage for part/nozzle/feeder events.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: Pick or placement is admitted when pose, part identity, nozzle, feeder, board and clearance states match.
auditable_absence: Expected component present but not observed under verified camera/feeder coverage.
candidate_metrics: Cycle time; mispicks; placement error; stoppages; energy/placed part.
minimum_pilot: One SMT cell in shadow or simulation mode.
principal_risks: Occlusion; calibration; part damage; false absence.

application: Additive manufacturing melt-pool event control
current_baseline: Layerwise systems collect images and sensor streams, often analysed after the layer or build.
proposed_role: Model melt-pool geometry, thermal state, feedstock and scan trajectory continuously; trigger corrective transitions at guard crossings.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance
exemplar_event_guard: Melt-pool, porosity-risk or thermal-gradient relation exits process support.
auditable_absence: Expected sensor or powder-delivery event absent blocks confidence.
candidate_metrics: Defect rate; scrap; energy/kg; latency; calibration.
minimum_pilot: Single material and geometry with high-speed sensing.
principal_risks: Complex multiphysics; sensor occlusion; actuation limits.

application: CNC and tool-wear next-event control
current_baseline: Machine tools rely on periodic inspection and signal-based condition monitoring.
proposed_role: Represent tool state, workpiece lineage and continuous load/vibration relations; predict wear threshold and collision events.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: Predicted wear, chatter, overload or collision guard crossing.
auditable_absence: Expected cut completion or sensor signature absent under verified coverage.
candidate_metrics: Tool life; scrap; downtime; false alarms; energy/part.
minimum_pilot: One machining process with historical data and shadow prediction.
principal_risks: Model drift; varying materials; sensor noise.

application: Industrial optical spectroscopy classifier
current_baseline: Spectrometers digitize full spectra even for narrow detection tasks.
proposed_role: Use tunable optical supports, mode compatibility and threshold events to detect selected chemical/physical signatures before or alongside full spectra.
core_operators: local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; analog/photonic front end; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Spectral/mode response crosses a calibrated target guard.
auditable_absence: Reference line absent indicates instrument fault; target absence requires full support coverage.
candidate_metrics: Events/J; limit of detection; false alarms; calibration; cost.
minimum_pilot: Known gas or liquid assay with simultaneous reference spectrometer.
principal_risks: Cross-sensitivity; drift; environmental dependence.

application: Quality inspection as direct relation query
current_baseline: Vision inspection often forms high-resolution images and runs dense models.
proposed_role: Use local support and event-based or analog prefilters for specific geometry, surface or assembly relations; retain images only for exceptions.
core_operators: local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; analog/photonic front end; materialized view; lineage/provenance
exemplar_event_guard: Feature deviation crosses tolerance under sufficient illumination and pose support.
auditable_absence: Expected feature not observed under verified coverage; otherwise unknown.
candidate_metrics: Bytes/part; events/J; miss/false; inspection time; exception-image rate.
minimum_pilot: Single repetitive inspection task.
principal_risks: Novel defects; lighting; model coverage; evidence retention.

application: Photonic relation kernel for fixed industrial queries
current_baseline: Digital hardware performs repeated fixed transforms and thresholds.
proposed_role: Map stable linear transforms to calibrated interferometric hardware, while nonlinear logic, uncertainty, lineage and policy remain digital.
core_operators: analog/photonic front end; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance
exemplar_event_guard: Optical output crosses a calibrated guard and digital sidecar validates context.
auditable_absence: Reference-channel absence or drift blocks result.
candidate_metrics: End-to-end events/J; accuracy; calibration; insertion loss; latency.
minimum_pilot: Small MZI mesh on one sensing or control task.
principal_risks: I/O and ADC costs; drift; precision; programmability.

application: Grid state and contingency query substrate
current_baseline: Grid operations combine estimators, SCADA/PMU streams, forecasts and periodic contingency studies.
proposed_role: Maintain a versioned grid state and solve local support, compatibility and next-limit events; use conventional power-flow solvers as typed physical services.
core_operators: direct state query; next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; counterfactual branch; lineage/provenance
exemplar_event_guard: Earliest thermal, voltage, frequency, stability or protection guard crossing under a scenario branch.
auditable_absence: Expected telemetry or breaker state absent is classified separately from a normal zero.
candidate_metrics: Contingency solve time; missed events; false alarms; operator workload; events/J.
minimum_pilot: Offline replay and shadow control-room pilot for one region.
principal_risks: Model error; cyber risk; event explosion; operator trust.

application: Distributed energy and microgrid compatibility router
current_baseline: DERs, batteries, EVs and loads are coordinated through heterogeneous protocols and control layers.
proposed_role: Use compatibility predicates for device capability, grid state, market/policy and ownership; route only admitted events.
core_operators: compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence; counterfactual branch
exemplar_event_guard: Dispatch or islanding transition admitted when electrical, contractual, cyber and timing predicates match.
auditable_absence: Expected device acknowledgment or telemetry absent after a verified communication window.
candidate_metrics: Dispatch success; interoperability failures; curtailment; resilience; cyber incidents.
minimum_pilot: Campus microgrid or simulated feeder.
principal_risks: Vendor heterogeneity; cyber attack; conflicting objectives.

application: Protection and disturbance event engine
current_baseline: Protection systems react to waveform thresholds with strict timing, while analytics may be separated.
proposed_role: Represent disturbance supports, device compatibility, guard crossings and event lineage explicitly; keep certified relays authoritative.
boundary: Addition to analysis and coordination, not unvalidated relay replacement.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: Fault or instability relation crosses a certified boundary in the protected zone.
auditable_absence: Expected breaker trip or relay acknowledgment absent within the mandated interval.
candidate_metrics: Detection time; selectivity; false trips; coordination; event reconstruction.
minimum_pilot: Digital real-time simulator with relay-in-the-loop.

application: Solar PV string and module event twin

candidate_metrics: Time to detect; recovery time; substitution success; scenario explainability.
minimum_pilot: One multi-tier component chain.
principal_risks: Supplier opacity; false rumors; branch explosion; strategic misuse.

application: Municipal service obligation and 311 event graph
current_baseline: 311 systems record requests but often separate promises, work orders, assets and outcomes.
proposed_role: Link requests, assets, departments, contractors, SLAs, inspections and resident communications through events and auditable absences.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; auditable absence; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Request, dispatch, work, inspection and closure are typed events with reason and evidence.
auditable_absence: Expected response, visit or resolution absent after its service window.
candidate_metrics: Resolution time; reopen rate; equity; evidence completeness; resident trust.
minimum_pilot: Pothole or streetlight service.
principal_risks: Gaming closure; surveillance; uneven digital access; contractor data.

application: Transit arrival and missed-service ledger
current_baseline: Passenger systems emphasize predictions and vehicle positions; missed trips may be poorly distinguished from missing telemetry.
proposed_role: Represent scheduled/expected service, vehicle lineage, stop support and observed arrivals; emit absence only with coverage.
core_operators: local support; auditable absence; lineage/provenance; guard/event surface; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Arrival/departure crosses stop/time support under a vehicle/run identity.
auditable_absence: Scheduled trip absent when AVL and operational coverage are verified; otherwise unknown/data gap.
candidate_metrics: On-time performance; ghost-trip classification; passenger delay; data coverage.
minimum_pilot: One bus corridor.
principal_risks: GPS outages; schedule changes; privacy; public misinterpretation.

application: Traffic, curb and intersection event control
current_baseline: Controllers operate with loops, phases and local sensors; planning and enforcement data are separate.
proposed_role: Use local spatial supports, vehicle/pedestrian compatibility and next-conflict events; preserve policy versions and human override.
core_operators: next-event solve; local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: Conflict, queue, pedestrian call, emergency preemption or curb-occupancy guard crossing.
auditable_absence: Expected detector or phase acknowledgment absent.
candidate_metrics: Delay; safety surrogate; emissions; false calls; accessibility.
minimum_pilot: One simulated or controlled intersection.
principal_risks: Safety; sensor bias; priority fairness; cyber.

application: Water, sewer, waste and street-asset lifecycle
current_baseline: Asset management is split across GIS, work orders, inspections and finance.
proposed_role: Give each asset lineage, condition events, local support and maintenance guards; connect physical and budget records.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; local support; guard/event surface; auditable absence; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Inspection, fault, maintenance, replacement and service events update asset state.
auditable_absence: Expected inspection, collection or repair absent under a service obligation.
candidate_metrics: Failure rate; backlog; lifecycle cost; service equity; auditability.
minimum_pilot: One asset class.
principal_risks: Legacy IDs; contractor boundaries; data quality.

application: Emergency response common event substrate
current_baseline: Calls, sensors, dispatch, hospitals and utilities exchange partial information.
proposed_role: Use a common incident lineage, local support, compatibility and event guards while preserving agency-specific sectors and permissions.
core_operators: local support; compatibility gate; guard/event surface; lineage/provenance; auditable absence; counterfactual branch
exemplar_event_guard: Incident, dispatch, arrival, hazard, capacity and handoff events are admitted under role and jurisdiction predicates.
auditable_absence: Expected unit acknowledgment or arrival absent within an explicit response window.
candidate_metrics: Response time; duplicate dispatch; handoff quality; privacy incidents.
minimum_pilot: Tabletop exercise and one low-risk event type.
principal_risks: Authority conflict; false data; surveillance; cyber.

application: Permitting, licensing and inspection event pipeline
current_baseline: Applicants face document-centric workflows with opaque state and missing-action delays.
proposed_role: Model application, evidence, review, inspection, decision, appeal and policy version as events with explicit compatibility and reason codes.
boundary: Addition/partial replacement of opaque workflow tracking.
core_operators: compatibility gate; lineage/provenance; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Decision transition admitted only when required evidence, authority, policy version and procedural rights are satisfied.
auditable_absence: Expected review or applicant response absent after due interval, with waiver/extension states.
candidate_metrics: Cycle time; rework; appeals; missing documents; transparency.
minimum_pilot: One permit type.
principal_risks: Automating discretion; unequal access; policy complexity.

application: Budget, procurement and contract lineage
current_baseline: Budgets and contracts are document-heavy and decisions are hard to reconstruct.
proposed_role: Create lineage from policy goal to appropriation, tender, bid, award, change order, invoice, delivery and outcome.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Financial or contractual transition carries authority, policy, evidence and before/after state.
auditable_absence: Expected deliverable, report or payment evidence absent.
candidate_metrics: Audit time; change-order visibility; duplicate spend; outcome linkage.
minimum_pilot: One capital project.
principal_risks: Commercial confidentiality; political misuse; data burden.

application: Policy simulation with isolated counterfactual branches
current_baseline: Municipal scenarios often live in separate spreadsheets/models and can contaminate operational assumptions.
proposed_role: Use branch-isolated policy worlds sharing base data; compare next events, service KPIs and distributional impacts without overwriting live state.
core_operators: counterfactual branch; direct state query; next-event solve; lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Policy-specific service, cost, risk or equity guard crossing.
auditable_absence: Missing evidence is shown as uncertainty, not zero impact.
candidate_metrics: Scenario reproducibility; runtime; KPI coverage; distributional impact; explainability.
minimum_pilot: Transport, housing or energy policy case.
principal_risks: False precision; biased models; branch explosion; political capture.

application: Rights-preserving municipal data spaces
current_baseline: Smart-city systems can centralize surveillance and blur purposes.
proposed_role: Use relational exclusion, purpose/time/role compatibility, provenance and public reason codes; co-location in a platform never implies join permission.
core_operators: compatibility gate; lineage/provenance; auditable absence; counterfactual branch
exemplar_event_guard: Data join admitted only for declared purpose, authority, minimization, retention and consent/legal basis.
auditable_absence: Expected deletion, review or access-log event absent triggers governance action.
candidate_metrics: Unauthorized joins; purpose violations; access audit; resident redress.
minimum_pilot: One cross-department data-sharing use case with privacy review.
principal_risks: Function creep; power imbalance; re-identification; opaque predicates.

application: Community well-being and service-outcome atlas
current_baseline: City dashboards emphasize technology and operational metrics.
proposed_role: Map technology events through infrastructure services to community benefits, with lineage and neighborhood support rather than one global score.
core_operators: local support; lineage/provenance; materialized view; auditable absence; counterfactual branch
exemplar_event_guard: Service outcome or disparity crosses a declared community guard.
auditable_absence: Expected service result absent, with data coverage and denominator explicit.
candidate_metrics: Service access; quality of life; equity; resilience; data completeness.
minimum_pilot: One service portfolio across neighborhoods.
principal_risks: Metric gaming; ecological fallacy; missing populations; privacy.

application: Claim-evidence-provenance graph
current_baseline: Reports and papers flatten claims, sources, methods and revisions into documents.
proposed_role: Represent claims, evidence, analyses, authorship, review and revision as a provenance graph; documents become materialized views.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Claim created, supported, challenged, revised or withdrawn with source and method lineage.
auditable_absence: Expected evidence, review or replication absent is explicit.
candidate_metrics: Traceability; review time; unsupported claims; reproducibility.
minimum_pilot: One technical report or evidence review.
principal_risks: Metadata burden; disagreement semantics; access rights.

application: Negative-result and non-observation registry
current_baseline: Research records positive observations more reliably than non-events or failed attempts.
proposed_role: Use ExpectedEvent/AbsenceEvent with protocol, detection support, power, deadline and reason to record meaningful non-observation.
core_operators: auditable absence; local support; compatibility gate; lineage/provenance; guard/event surface
exemplar_event_guard: A pre-registered expected observation expires under adequate detection support without a compatible event.
auditable_absence: This is the core absence use case.
candidate_metrics: Publication bias; repeat failures; power/coverage quality; reuse.
minimum_pilot: One lab or benchmark suite.
principal_risks: Misclassified nulls; poor power; reputational incentives.

application: Electronic lab notebook as event-sourced experiment
current_baseline: ELNs store entries and attachments but may not reconstruct instrument, sample and analysis state.
proposed_role: Record protocol, material, instrument, operator, environment, observation and transformation events with lineage.
boundary: Addition/partial replacement of page-centric ELN history.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Experiment transition emits before/after state, instrument calibration, sample lineage and confidence.
auditable_absence: Expected run, calibration or sample event absent.
candidate_metrics: Reproducibility; audit time; missing metadata; onboarding.
minimum_pilot: One instrument workflow.
principal_risks: Instrumentation integration; user burden; IP security.

application: Living systematic review and evidence map
current_baseline: Reviews are periodic documents and rapidly become stale.
proposed_role: Maintain study, population, intervention, outcome, bias and claim events; materialize current reviews by query.
core_operators: direct state query; lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Study or result changes the support for a claim under a versioned inclusion predicate.
auditable_absence: Expected registry result or follow-up publication absent is tracked as pending/unknown.
candidate_metrics: Update latency; citation coverage; reproducibility; conflict visibility.
minimum_pilot: One narrow research question.
principal_risks: Automated screening errors; paywalls; publication bias.

application: Regulatory and quality-management evidence bundle
current_baseline: Submissions assemble requirements, tests, risks, changes and approvals from many repositories.
proposed_role: Use event lineage and compatibility to generate auditable, version-specific evidence bundles.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; counterfactual branch; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Requirement, design, test, deviation, risk control and approval events link to a release.
auditable_absence: Expected verification or approval absent blocks release.
candidate_metrics: Audit prep time; trace gaps; change impact; defect escape.
minimum_pilot: One product change or submission section.
principal_risks: Tool qualification; legal interpretation; access control.

application: Software and computational-environment lineage
current_baseline: Results depend on code, packages, containers, hardware and runtime parameters.
proposed_role: Treat environment and execution as lineage events; reconstruct exact branch and artifacts for each result.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; counterfactual branch; compatibility gate; auditable absence
exemplar_event_guard: Run event links code commit, dependencies, data, hardware, parameters and outputs.
auditable_absence: Expected artifact or checksum absent.
candidate_metrics: Reproduction success; build time; provenance completeness.
minimum_pilot: One analysis pipeline.
principal_risks: External services; nondeterminism; storage.

application: Research portfolio and funding lineage
current_baseline: Projects, grants, datasets, outputs and impacts are stored in separate systems.
proposed_role: Build lineage from question and funding to experiments, assets, outputs, reuse and societal outcomes without collapsing evaluation into one score.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; local support; compatibility gate; auditable absence; materialized view
exemplar_event_guard: Funding, milestone, dataset, publication, reuse and outcome events preserve attribution.
auditable_absence: Expected deliverable or data release absent with documented reason.
candidate_metrics: Duplication; reuse; time to evidence; administrative burden.
minimum_pilot: One program portfolio.
principal_risks: Metric gaming; attribution complexity; privacy.

application: Knowledge transfer and institutional memory substrate
current_baseline: Organizations lose rationale when staff, files and tools change.
proposed_role: Store decisions, assumptions, predicates, evidence and outcomes as lineage-aware events; documents and dashboards are generated views.
core_operators: lineage/provenance; compatibility gate; auditable absence; materialized view; direct state query
exemplar_event_guard: Decision or rule change records context, authority, evidence, alternatives and consequences.
auditable_absence: Expected review or retirement event absent.
candidate_metrics: Onboarding time; repeated mistakes; decision traceability; stale rules.
minimum_pilot: One engineering program or municipal department.
principal_risks: Over-documentation; sensitive reasoning; cultural adoption.
